paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is currently 2.54, with a change of -2.87% compared to the prior close, and -37.1% over the last 22 trading sessions. There has been 1 new news item in the last 24 hours.

There have been various SEC filings, including 4 Form 4 filings and 3 Form 144 filings, with the most recent ones occurring on October 22 and October 20, respectively.
